hardGateFindings.finding: Hiring-reader comprehension, collaborator agreement, application results, production approval, and hiring effectiveness remain explicitly not-yet-measured. Reader testing, solicitation, and job-search follow-through are planned actions with no returned receipts; repository controls and LLM scores are not presented as external outcomes.

All eight blind spots have distinct signals, current states, control artifacts, triggers, owners, next tests, decision rules, and safe evidence-return paths. The current graph contains 60 intake records, 233 sources, 104 claims, 33 inquiries, 61 active projections, and 45 held projections; exact-set ledgers cover 54 Jamie-naming claims and 29 public proof claims, while all 14 concrete public routes remain within their composition budgets.

The contract separates deterministic validation, distinct read-only LLM judgments, orchestration provenance, and external human evidence, and describes repository provenance as auditable process evidence rather than cryptographic proof. The stored prior run is bound to a different digest and is not evidence for this fresh cycle; this judgment still requires a separate orchestration receipt.

Record-level Knowledge Bank boundaries and the current digest-bound mosaic review jointly govern names, affiliations, movement history, platform interactions, protected educational records, reader feedback, and relationship graphs. Protected locators and underlying artifacts remain non-public, private feedback stays outside the repository, and the mosaic receipt disclaims legal, participant, collaborator, and human privacy approval.

limitations: This is an independent LLM evaluation of repository controls, not human reader research, collaborator corroboration, participant review, legal review, production approval, or evidence of hiring effectiveness.

The five-reader study, hiring-reader solicitation, and outward job-search follow-through remain planned; their absence limits actionability to 4 and leaves all associated external outcomes unmeasured.

The bundle digest was independently recomputed and matched, but the current-run pointer still references prior-digest results. The full checker therefore rejects only those stale result and judge artifacts until this fresh cycle is separately recorded.
Protected and private underlying artifacts were not independently inspected; this judgment evaluates their public-safe representations, evidence relationships, guardrails, and publication boundaries.
The mosaic review is an internal Codex control receipt and cannot substitute for collaborator, participant, legal, rights, or human privacy review.
